cycle.label: Reporting period
cycle.note: Alaska licenses expire December 31 of odd-numbered years. CPE: 80 hours over the two calendar years, at least 20 in each year, 4 of them ethics (12 AAC 04.300).

requirements.label: Micro-learning
requirements.note: Maximum, not a target. Activities shorter than an hour (micro-learning) count for no more than 10 hours a period (12 AAC 04.300(e)). We count nano-learning courses.

requirements.label: Ethics
requirements.note: 4 hours of ethics each period (12 AAC 04.300(d)). Any approved ethics course counts; no Alaska-specific course is required.

newLicensee.note: Licenses first issued during this period need no CPE for their first renewal (Board renewal form).

licenseDateHint: Alaska licenses expire December 31 of odd-numbered years (e.g. 12/31/2027).
issueDateHint: If your license was first issued during this period, no CPE is due for your first renewal.
limitsNotTracked: From 2026: no more than 12 hours count for any one day.
Instructor credit: max 30 hours a period (preparation up to twice the teaching time).
Published articles and books no longer earn credit.
recordRetention: Keep CPE documentation for at least 4 years (renewal form).
toVerify: First-renewal exemption comes from the renewal form (licenses first issued in the period), not the regulation text.
Micro-learning = any activity under an hour; we only count courses whose format is Nano Learning.
